question:
How many stars are both Tyres and Pen?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2af11cceeb1fff17c62762bce00841eb0a9142637eb5e5a4fa8dbd99105530f4.png]
solution:
In the given diagram-

 
• Sections under star are- 3, **2**, 6
 
• Sections under tyre and star are- 3, **2**
 
• Section under pen and star is- **2**
 
• Section common to star, tyre and pen- **2**

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/97f165e4535e3993276f48aab4e633db982893a2c6bc227a254cd8b58e933b69.png] 

Hence, **'option 1' **is the correct answer.
